dataformat.name: lzf
dataformat.title: LZF Deflate Compression
dataformat.description: Compress and decompress streams using LZF deflate algorithm
dataformat.label: dataformat,transformation

marshalIn.description: The data to compress: text in the charset of the exchange, bytes, a stream or a file

marshalOut.description: The LZF data in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off

unmarshalIn.description: LZF data, such as marshal gives, with or without usingParallelCompression

unmarshalOut.description: The decompressed data in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off

usingParallelCompression.description: Whether to enable encoding (compress) using multiple processing cores.
